body: Late at night, Saul came out to get Robert L.'s water going, and he was back early the next day to wrap things up. Angela B. had a broken water line replaced, plus the outside faucet, with the estimate and the work done in one whirlwind afternoon.

sections.heading: Burst Pipes, a Flooded Home, and a Call Every Time
body: A flood from burst pipes, then a leaking washer hose: Christopher C. has been through both. The crew replaced all the lines in his home with PEX, with minimal wall damage. Prices were fair and quoted upfront, he wrote, and now JM is his call for every plumbing need.

sections.quote: JM Plumbing arrived when he said he would, professionally assessed the situation which involved 70 year old galvanized pipe, and gave us several options.

sections.heading: Hard Rain, Failing Sump Pump
body: After hard rains, Austin A.'s sump pump was failing. JM came out the afternoon he noticed, replaced the pump without any problems, and charged what he called a very fair price.
A busy time and a sump pump issue: Hunter M. had his fixed within two hours, and the technician, Greg, gave him options for a fix and explained the scenarios.

sections.heading: A Plastic Object in the Toilet Line, and Booties at the Door
body: Cristina M. found JM on Google because of the high star rating. They answered on the first call and quoted close to half what a few large companies wanted. The next day they called ahead, and two men arrived in a marked vehicle and put booties on before coming in.

They listened, explained what they would do and the possible outcomes, and restated the price before starting. They cleared the line with an auger, checked the main line outside, had her flush to confirm, and handed over a copy of the work order.

sections.heading: One Quote of $1,800 Out of Five Places
body: Jordan R. called five places about a water line for his mom. JM's quote was $1,800, the best of the five, and they did the work the next day. Mrs. A. says JM came in way under what others had quoted.
For John S., the crew came for free, fixed a small clog and didn't charge him a dime.

sections.heading: Found on Facebook, Then Called Again

Shelly S. called the night before, and JM was out first thing the next morning. JM has worked on both of her sons' homes.

sections.heading: A Sunday Septic Backup, Found and Priced
body: Noel S. had been in his house a month when the downstairs shower backed up and flooded the bathroom. It was a weekend, and he wrote that JM was the only company that answered his request for emergency help.

The crew came out on a Sunday and found that roots had infiltrated the line. He wrote that the price was less than he imagined, and that they gave him advice and tips to prevent the damage and recommended replacing the damaged line.

sections.quote: Jaime and his crew were practically immediate in their response to my sewer line needing to be cleared and partially replaced. They were friendly, completely professional, and what I appreciated most was their excellent communication and keeping me apprised of the work and my options every step of the way.
sections.name: Jay P.

sections.heading: Months of Backups, Then a Cleanout
body: Months of backups with no cleanout: that was Justice W.'s house until JM installed one quickly, at what she called a very affordable price. She wrote that it was such a stress relief.
Sewer was backing up into Stuart I.'s basement floor drain. The crew fixed the problem and cleaned up when they were done.
Carol J. called about a floor drain. Jaime found the issue immediately, came out on a weekend day to fix it, and did it quickly.

sections.heading: A Collapsed Line, a Day and a Half, and the Patio Put Back
body: Katherine B. had JM replace a collapsed line. The job took about a day and a half, and the crew talked with her and her husband about what was going on and explained what they would be doing.
Getting to the pipe meant breaking up their concrete patio, and the crew put it back together to the best of their abilities. She named Tanner, Zeb, Saul and Jaime as fantastic at their jobs.

sections.heading: A Late-Night Clog, and a Return Visit
body: Many companies got a late-night call from William W. about a main line drain clog, and he was happy to get an answer from a very nice dispatcher. The tech was there within the time frame, and the price was reasonable.
The next morning the tech returned to put the correct size wax ring back on the toilet. Lili S. had a sewer backup in mid-December, and JM picked up the phone after hours.

sections.heading: New Lines and Cleanouts, on Different Occasions
body: JM fixed Angela L.'s sewer line, and has done cleanouts and added new lines for her on different occasions.
When Sarah V.'s sewer line gave her trouble, the crew responded promptly and replaced it. She wrote that they did an exceptional job.

lead.heading: Why we led with explaining what's wrong
lead.text: The scariest moment for a Wichita homeowner is the water off and a stranger at the door, and right behind it is not knowing whether the repair is real. We led with explaining what's wrong and why because it is built on things Google can't find anywhere else: what your customers say about how you explain, and Wichita details like a floor drain, a collapsed line and a Sunday faucet. That is also why it can help you rank.
